name: Starburst fireworks
doc: GPU-simulated firework starbursts triggered on audio onsets, with burst scale driven by loudness, palette-colored chrysanthemum, willow, and ring shells, gravity arcs, and glowing spark trails.

palette.doc: colors each firework shell, spark core, and fading willow trail

burst_scale.doc: burst radius and launch velocity multiplier

gravity.doc: downward gravitational pull on firework sparks

trails.doc: persistence of glowing spark trails in the sky

sparkle.doc: high-frequency crackle and glitter twinkle on dying sparks
